html:
Cu Chi is known for its famous landmarks, delicious food, unique festivals, and more than that, it is also a place with a strong historical mark, and let’s take a look at the 5 famous tourist attractions in Cu Chi below.

Cu Chi Tunnels

The first destination that cannot be missed in the Southern Vietnam tour, the relic site has a strong historical mark, during the war this place was an underground defense system, if you go in a group, you will hear an explanation about this historical relic site.

Cu Chi Water Park

A suitable entertainment spot for families with children, the whole family can participate in water games here, which will bring visitors the most perfect vacation.

Trung An Fruit Garden

Every year in the summer, which is also the season of ripe fruit, tourists from all over the world often come here to visit and enjoy the ripe fruits right in the garden, which will bring them a sense of excitement.

Binh My Eco-tourism Area

Coming here, visitors will be immersed in a poetic space, as if rushing back to their childhood memories, where there are village ponds, monkey bridges, bamboo fences and cool green coconut trees, simple roofs where visitors can experience fishing on the pond bank, cruising on the river, catching fish with a net, … folk games but bring visitors a sense of excitement.

Fosaco Eco-Village

Located about 10km from the city center, where there is a cool green space, a peaceful space is an ideal stop for visitors’ vacation.
